name: Canal Road Animal Hospital
description: Canal Road Animal Hospital is a privately owned veterinary hospital in the Orange Beach, AL area. We consider ourselves a member of the community and are always happy to serve our clients--both humans and pets! Julianna Taylor, D.V.M. and Teresa Russell, D.V.M. will take great care of your pets - from animal medicine and surgery to digital radiography surgery. Dr. Taylor and Dr. Russell provides emergency care and complete diagnostic testing for your pets. Our friendly veterinary surgeons in Orange Beach will allow you to choose what types of treatments you desire for your pet, and we are also happy to advise you should you want to discuss a variety of options. Canal Road Animal Hospital provides complete, compassionate veterinary care in the Orange Beach, AL area. If you are searching for a team of professionals that will treat your pet gently each and every time they visit, give us a call today. We also treat pets from Gulf Shores, Foley, and the surrounding areas. We know that visits to the vet can be stressful for both the pet and the caregiver. We strive to take the worry away by providing excellent, streamlined care--at a price that you can afford. Dr. Julianna Taylor's and Dr. Teresa Russell's team at our veterinary care clinic in Orange Beach is here to put you and your pet at ease as we provide the necessary care to ensure that your pet leads a normal, healthy life. We believe that a preventative approach is the best way to give your pet a long and healthy life. We encourage our clients to bring their animals in on a regular basis so that we can help keep their shots up to date, and to let them grow accustomed to seeing us! We're Orange Beach's full service veterinary care clinic. From routine check-ups and wellness visits, to more urgent care and even surgical needs, the team here is ready to tackle any issue your pet may be facing. Our veterinarian provides great care for pets in Orange Beach, Foley, AL and surrounding areas. Not only are we widely known as Orange Beach's most compassionate veterinary clinic, we're also known as one of the most affordable. At Canal Road Animal Hospital, we appreciate the current state of the economy, and never want to let that stand in the way of providing area pets and their owners with the pet care they deserve. That's why we aim to keep our costs down without sacrificing the quality of care we provide.
